entries.section: 大作文第一段（图画类）
entries.en: The picture presents a thought-provoking scene in which {图片描述句}. Simple as the picture may seem, the message it conveys is profound, reminding us of the significance of {题目相关词} in real life.
entries.zh: 这幅图呈现了一个发人深思的场景，画中{图片描述句}。图片看似简单，但它传递的信息却十分深刻，提醒我们{题目相关词}在现实生活中的重要意义。
notes: 注意！可不是让你把「图片描述句」这几个字翻译成英文！而是把题目中的图画用英文自己写、自己描述
题目相关词可以是不同的英文单词，不一定全篇的题目相关词都是一样的

entries.section: 大作文第一段（材料类）
entries.en: The material presents a thought-provoking phenomenon concerning {题目相关词}. Simple as the material may seem, the message it conveys is profound, reminding us of the significance of {题目相关词} in real life.
entries.zh: 这段材料呈现了一个与{题目相关词}有关的发人深思的现象。材料看似简单，但它传递的信息却十分深刻，提醒我们{题目相关词}在现实生活中的重要意义。
notes: 也有可能考材料类，就是题目给你一段文字让你写，这个时候把这幅画改成这段材料就行了

entries.section: 大作文第二段（校园类／正面品质）
entries.en: Viewed within the context of everyday life, it is hardly surprising that {题目相关词} can bring considerable benefits. First, the exemplary role played by elders in daily conduct enables children to perceive the positive influence of {题目相关词} more directly and to internalize this quality gradually. Second, {题目相关词} allows individuals to cope with difficulties and challenges with greater ease. In addition, those who are long influenced by {题目相关词} tend to develop a clearer understanding of the future and more thoughtful plans for it.

entries.origin: 精讲1：温室花朵（03 年）· 图画描述主句
entries.section: 图画作文第一段·图画描述（环境+人/物+动作+文字）
entries.originalText: Inside a huge warm house, there is a little and delicate flower, growing vigorously and blossoming, with the house protecting it from the outside severe weather.
entries.en: Inside {环境}, there is {主体}, {伴随动作}, with {周围事物} {周围事物状态}.
entries.zh: 在{环境}中，有{主体}，{伴随动作}，{周围事物}{周围事物状态}。

examples.label: 03 年英语一真题（温室花朵）
examples.en: Inside a huge warm house, there is a little and delicate flower, growing vigorously and blossoming, with the house protecting it from the outside severe weather.
examples.zh: 在一个巨大的温室中，有一个小而精致的花朵，在茁壮成长中开花，周围的房子保护着它免受外部的暴风雨。

notes: 图画描述公式：环境+人/物+动作+文字
语法现象1：介词短语表环境
语法现象2：There be 句式引出相关的人和物
语法现象3：人和物之后使用 v-ing 形式/v-ed 表伴随的动作；v-ing 表主动，v-ed 表被动
语法现象4：with+名词+v-ing/v-ed/介词/形容词短语 → 表身上或周围的事物

entries.zh: 尽管{主体}在{原环境}中看起来{正面状态}，但当它被放置在{新环境}之后，很快就{负面变化}，{伴随细节}。
notes: 语法现象5：although 引导让步状语，表反差

entries.zh: 这种现象非常值得关注，因为这些人可能沉溺于{沉溺对象}，忽略了现实生活中的{被忽略对象}。

In front of many options stand a host of graduates, staring/looking at four directions: creating their ow businesses/firms/companies, going abroad, preparing for the national entrance examination for postgraduate studies, and hunting for jobs.

entries.origin: 3.3 变化类词汇与句式 · 例句（上升）
entries.section: 图表作文 动态·上升趋势例句
entries.originalText: From 1977 to 1980, there was an upward trend in the number of birds, from 120 million to the highest point/peak at approximately/about/some 127 million.
entries.en: From {起始年份} to {结束年份}, there was an upward trend in the number of {数据主体}, from {起始数值} to the highest point at approximately {峰值}.
entries.zh: 从{起始年份}到{结束年份}，{数据主体}的数量呈上升趋势，从{起始数值}升至约{峰值}的最高点。
notes: 上升名词：an increase to/by..., a rise, a growth, a jump, a surge, a boom, an upward trend
entries.pageTitle: 3.3 变化类词汇与句式（趋势描述五大句型）

entries.origin: 3.3 变化类词汇与句式 · 例句（平稳）
entries.section: 图表作文 动态·平稳趋势例句
entries.originalText: Before 2007, there had been a steady rise in the subscription number of mobile phones in developed nations, and it remained stable at 1 billion in 2008.
entries.en: Before {年份}, there had been a steady rise in {数据主体}, and it remained stable at {数值} in {结束年份}.
entries.zh: 在{年份}之前，{数据主体}稳步上升，并在{结束年份}稳定在{数值}。
notes: 平稳不变动词：level out/off；did not change at
持续上升/下降：keep going up；maintained a downward trend；demonstrate the trend of saturation
entries.pageTitle: 3.3 变化类词汇与句式（趋势描述五大句型）

entries.origin: 【句型句法】1）主谓
entries.section: 图表作文 句型一·主谓（数据主体做主语）
entries.originalText: Between 1940 and 1985, the proportion （比例）of the elderly （老年的）people increased remarkably （明显地）from approximately 7% in Sweden and 9% in the USA to 13% and 15% respectively （分别地）.
entries.en: Between {起始年份} and {结束年份}, the proportion of {数据主体} increased remarkably from approximately {起始数值A} in {对象A} and {起始数值B} in {对象B} to {结束数值A} and {结束数值B} respectively.
entries.zh: 在{起始年份}到{结束年份}之间，{数据主体}的比例明显上升，从{对象A}的约{起始数值A}和{对象B}的{起始数值B}分别升至{结束数值A}和{结束数值B}。
notes: 句型一：数据主体做主语 + v（increase/decrease）
respectively 表示分别地，用于多对象并列
变化程度原则：形容词修饰名词，副词修饰动词、形容词、副词、句子
entries.pageTitle: 3.3 变化类词汇与句式（趋势描述五大句型）

entries.origin: 【句型句法】2）主谓宾
entries.section: 图表作文 句型二·主谓宾（呈现出变化）
entries.originalText: During the two decades from 1990 to 2010, the proportion of the old showed a considerable surge of 12%, reaching (arriving at) 35%.
entries.en: During the period from {起始年份} to {结束年份}, the proportion of {数据主体} showed a considerable surge of {变化幅度}, reaching {结束数值}.
entries.zh: 在{起始年份}到{结束年份}这段时间里，{数据主体}的比例大幅激增{变化幅度}，达到{结束数值}。
notes: 句型二：主体 + 呈现/表现出（show/demonstrate/display）+ 变化（名词）
语法点：v-ing 表伴随，主谓一致，且两个动作几乎同时发生
entries.pageTitle: 3.3 变化类词汇与句式（趋势描述五大句型）

entries.origin: 【句型句法】3）主谓宾（拟人）
entries.section: 图表作文 句型三·拟人（年代/地点做主语）
entries.originalText: The period from 1940 to 1985 witnessed a steady and slight growth in the proportion of...
entries.en: The period from {起始年份} to {结束年份} witnessed a steady and slight growth in the proportion of {数据主体}.
entries.zh: 从{起始年份}到{结束年份}这段时期，{数据主体}的比例稳步小幅增长。
notes: 句型三：年代/地点 + saw/witnessed + 变化（名词），是拟人化表达，比主谓句更显文采
entries.pageTitle: 3.3 变化类词汇与句式（趋势描述五大句型）

entries.origin: 【句型句法】4）there be 句式
entries.section: 图表作文 句型四·there be 句式
entries.originalText: From （从…开始）this year onward, there was a gradual growth in the number of students who attended online courses, reaching the peak at 2.3 billion.
entries.en: From {起始年份} onward, there was a gradual growth in the number of {数据主体}, reaching the peak at {峰值}.
entries.zh: 从{起始年份}起，{数据主体}的数量逐步增长，达到{峰值}的峰值。
notes: 句型四：There was + increase in...
From...onward 表示从某时间起
entries.pageTitle: 3.3 变化类词汇与句式（趋势描述五大句型）

entries.origin: 【句型句法】5）主谓（变化发生在）

entries.en: A considerable increase in the number of {数据主体} occurred during {时间段}, from {起始数值} to {结束数值}.
entries.zh: {数据主体}的数量在{时间段}期间大幅增长，从{起始数值}增至{结束数值}。
notes: 句型五：变化（名词做主语）+ 发生在（occurred）+ 时间段

entries.originalText: To begin with, this project is organized to help those children in remote rural primary schools, whose families are so impoverished that they cannot afford tuition.
